validity.recommendation: reclassify PipelineType as transmission (an отвод feeding INTO a ГРС is the upstream/trunk side, not the downstream distribution network)
validity.researcher_notes: The row's own local name -- 'Газопровод-отвод ГРС «Гдов» Псковской области - Сланцы Завод Ленинградской области' -- and the harvested source's title 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Гдов» Псковской области' both describe a газопровод-отвод (branch pipeline) terminating AT a ГРС (gas distribution station), tapping an existing network near Slantsy. Per this batch's documented distribution-vs-transmission test (SOP guidance for R3): a магистральный газопровод / газопровод-отвод feeding a ГРС is the TRUNK/transmission asset, run by a Gazprom Transgaz subsidiary; the межпоселковый network downstream of the ГРС is the distribution side. Every other 'X — ГРС Y'-named row in this batch's roster (e.g. P4092 Приозерск-ГРС «Ихала», P4149 Бежаницы-ГРС «Новоржев») matches this same отвод pattern. No source explicitly classifies this specific object either way, so this is a naming-convention flag, not a sourced correction -- hence no PipelineType fill was staged (left UNRESOLVED), and the correction is proposed here instead.

validity.researcher_notes: This row's full name pairs a REAL, still-open Pskov Oblast gasification object ('Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Гдов» Псковской области', confirmed in both the 2022 and current 2026-06-08 editions of gazprommap.ru/pskovskaya/, point-30, done:0) with a claimed connection to 'an existing pipeline network near Slantsy, Leningrad Oblast' (per gem.wiki's own Location prose). Neither harvested citation supports the Slantsy half: the Leningrad Oblast programme page (gazprommap.ru/lenobl/, 121 objects) contains zero occurrences of 'Гдов' or 'Сланцы' and does not describe any cross-oblast interconnector toward Pskov; its four Слащевский-district ('Сланцевского района') objects are unrelated local межпоселковый distribution lines, not a link to Gdov. The routes-repo geojson (P4172.geojson) is a 2-point straight line whose endpoint (59.110N, 28.096E) lands almost exactly on Slantsy town -- but a 2-point 'low'-accuracy line is consistent with having been drawn directly FROM the row's stated endpoint names rather than from independent route evidence, so it does not corroborate the claim on its own. GEM's own Researcher (ZK) left ResearcherNotes = 'didn't find any info', consistent with this being an unverified pairing rather than a confirmed single project. This is not flagged as a full existence concern -- the Gdov-side отvod object plainly exists and is real -- but the specific claim that it connects to / originates near Slantsy in Leningrad Oblast is unconfirmed by any source checked this session (WebSearch budget exhausted; curl-based Bing/DuckDuckGo/Yandex searches were blocked or returned unrelated results in this sandbox).
